Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates diffuse interstitial markings (reticular pattern) throughout both lung fields, which is characteristic of interstitial lung disease. This pathology typically leads to reduced lung compliance and consequently decreased lung volumes (a restrictive pattern), which directly contributes to ventilatory insufficiency. Options suggesting hyperinflation or normal volumes are inconsistent with the visible diffuse fibrotic/interstitial changes.
